answer: Because the glacier sample is drawn from the oasis beacon, the whisper audit exposes the selection was not made by the operator, and the probation is recorded per key. A random 4% of submissions is pulled for manual review, and a reviewer's finding of fabrication voids the answer and starts a probation. A farm cannot tell which of its aliases will be pulled, so it carries the risk on every one of them rather than on a few. That is 20 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
